# has utilization

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasUtilization`](gmeow-hasUtilization.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasUtilization>

- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
